text: 此刻你有多放鬆？
source: 單題即時自評（每段之後重複測量，概念同生態瞬時評量 EMA）

text: 我覺得平靜。
source: Korpela, Ylén, Tyrväinen & Silvennoinen (2008) Restoration Outcome Scale, Health & Place 14(4)

text: 我對日常的事情有熱情、有活力。
source: Korpela, Ylén, Tyrväinen & Silvennoinen (2008) Restoration Outcome Scale, Health & Place 14(4)

text: 我覺得恢復了精神，很放鬆。
source: Korpela, Ylén, Tyrväinen & Silvennoinen (2008) Restoration Outcome Scale, Health & Place 14(4)

text: 我能好好專心，頭腦清醒。
source: Korpela, Ylén, Tyrväinen & Silvennoinen (2008) Restoration Outcome Scale, Health & Place 14(4)

text: 我能忘掉日常的煩惱。
source: Korpela, Ylén, Tyrväinen & Silvennoinen (2008) Restoration Outcome Scale, Health & Place 14(4)

text: 我的思緒很清晰。
source: Korpela, Ylén, Tyrväinen & Silvennoinen (2008) Restoration Outcome Scale, Health & Place 14(4)

text: 待在這裡是一種逃離的體驗。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14

text: 在這裡的時光，讓我從日常例行的事務中喘一口氣。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14

text: 這是一個可以遠離一切的地方。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14

text: 待在這裡，讓我不再一心想著要把事情做完。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14

text: 來到這裡，讓我不必再應付那些不想理會、卻一直要我注意的事。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14

text: 這個地方有令人著迷的特質。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14

text: 我的注意力被許多有趣的事物吸引。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14

text: 我想更認識這個地方。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14

text: 這裡有很多可以探索、發現的東西。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14

text: 我想多花一點時間看看四周的景物。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14

text: 這個地方很無聊。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14

text: 這個環境很迷人。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14

text: 這裡沒有什麼值得看的。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14

text: 這裡同時發生的事情太多了。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14

text: 這是一個令人困惑的地方。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14

text: 這裡有很多讓人分心的東西。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14

text: 這裡很混亂。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14

text: 待在這裡很適合我的個性。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14

text: 我可以在這裡做我喜歡的事。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14

text: 我覺得我屬於這裡。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14

text: 我可以找到讓自己樂在其中的方式。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14

text: 我覺得自己和這個環境融為一體。
source: Hartig, Korpela, Evans & Gärling (1997) Perceived Restorativeness Scale, Scandinavian Housing and Planning Research 14
